summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by Isabella Bank Corporation to announce a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.28 per share declared by its Board of Directors. The dividend is payable on June 30, 2026 to shareholders of record as of June 26, 2026. The filing contains no merger, acquisition, activist activity, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation event. The dividend announcement is ordinary-course capital return and does not represent a special situation requiring classification under any listed category. No deal terms or advisors are mentioned.
